package: WP-Z4d: B3-H3 L1 attempt 6 = replication of the attempt-5 private/escalate canon PASS on two fresh data seeds
recipe: identical to attempt 5 (b3_l1_v5_bench.run_task and main called unchanged; only SEED_DATA and the overlap report are replaced): recv_cond aux bridge + Bridge.refit_readout, 64 B message K=4 r=8 h=16, l1_gate, baselines/controls, splits 60/20/20, 5 paired split seeds, both views
states: NEW B1/B2 states per data seed, computed after this preregistration is pushed
gate: G-CALLOSUM-UTILITY-002 via unchanged b3bridge.l1_gate (BYTES_W .25, BYTES_NORM 4000, paired mean-2se>0, role_drop<=.01, ood<=.05, reload identical)

tasks.escalate: TARGET of the replication (attempt-5 canon PASS)

verdict_rule: Per data seed and task: canon L1 PASS = l1_gate PASS against label word AND attribute words (as attempt 5). private/escalate is REPLICATED only if canon PASS on BOTH fresh seeds; PASS on exactly one = SEED_DEPENDENT; on none = NOT_REPLICATED. apologize/action: same three labels reported, no gate decision beyond that. strict SCALAR reported as claim limit. Each seed runs once; no re-run with changed settings counts; FAIL stays FAIL.

consequence.REPLICATED: escalate L1 counts as robust over 3 data seeds; an L2 prefix SHADOW run on private/escalate may be preregistered next; LATENT authority stays 0, runtime unchanged
consequence.SEED_DEPENDENT: escalate L1 PASS treated as fragile like action; no L2 step on escalate; next = more data per seed or a stronger channel, not a new readout tweak
consequence.NOT_REPLICATED: attempt-5 PASS treated as a seed effect; B3_LATENT stays unavailable; L2 stays locked

expectation: attempt 5 escalate margin over attribute words was +0.056 utility (5/5 split seeds); attribute-word strength varied by 2 points between data seeds, so one of two fresh seeds failing is plausible
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud CPU, 4 threads, seeds run sequentially; not Redmi
